description.value: Aggarwal Sweets is a 100% vegetarian Indian sweets and cuisine restaurant with over 20 years of history serving the South Asian community in Surrey, located in the Payal Business Center. Founded to bring connoisseur-quality Indian sweets made with pure desi ghee to Canada, it offers an extensive menu spanning appetizers, snacks, South Indian dishes, paneer dishes, paranthas, desserts, and freshly made traditional sweets. A second location has recently opened at 6899 King George Blvd, Surrey.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business as a 100% vegetarian Indian sweets and cuisine restaurant at 8158 128 St, Surrey, BC, matching the OSM address and phone. The website prominently advertises '100% Vegetarian' and features an online ordering cart plus explicit mention of counter purchase and pre-order for pick-up, confirming takeout. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-relevant amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Richmond' but the business address is clearly in Surrey, BC per both OSM addr tags and the website — the community assignment appears to be erroneous.
OSM opening_hours (10:00-20:30) differ from the hours shown on the website for the 128 St location — website value may be more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate operating restaurant with confirmed takeout and a fully vegetarian menu, which is useful for touring cyclists, but none of the required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify minimum required criteria before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business operates two Surrey locations; this OSM record corresponds to the original 128 Street (Payal Business Center) location.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states '100% Vegetarian' and '100% vegetarian kitchen' throughout; no mention of vegan or gluten-free options
